description:
Search the Federal Register for rules, proposed rules, and notices affecting energy, petrochemical, and industrial companies. Track recent regulatory changes from EPA, OSHA, PHMSA, and DOT. Get full details for any Federal Register document including CFR references, effective dates, and comment periods.
3 free public tools — no authentication required:

public_search_federal_register — Search by agency, keyword, document type, and date range
public_list_recent_rules — List recent proposed and final rules from energy-related agencies
public_get_rule_details — Get full document details by Federal Register document number

Raw public data from federalregister.gov. Built by AiGNITE Consulting LLC, Houston, TX.
For AI-powered regulatory impact analysis with facility-specific applicability assessment, visit regscopeai.com.
Homepage: https://regscopeai.com
